what: Dots for each section sit on a horizontal bar at the bottom of the screen, and a character (bird) runs along, filling the bar up to the spot being read. Each time the screen center passes a section’s center it moves to the next dot, hops 5px at the middle of each span and tilts ±3°, and turns to face backward when scrolling up. Passing a dot, that section’s label rises from 5px lower left in .37s, and on reaching the last section the bar is completely filled

options.[data-fx-part=drag]: Filling bar (inside the same parent as the dot)
options.[data-fx-part=point]: A dot per section — section selector in data-target, label text in data-name. The last dot is the end section
options.[data-fx-part=runner]: (Optional) Running character — receives its jump through the style’s --y and --deg

use: Bird
note: Only the is-enter·is-turning·is-goal·is-active classes are attached, so the shapes (transform of the bar · dot · jump) are set in the consuming CSS

from.where: shared.js .mj-bar — original ScrollBar (fg: section dots·bird bob 5px/3°·label .37s)
